page0.text:
After dinner.
I finished cleaning up and face Saber in the dojo.
I tell her what happened today and how we eliminated the Bounded Field at school. And how Tohsaka anticipates that there'll be a counterattack tomorrow.

page1.text:
...I don't tell her about Shinji.
I don't want her to consider him an enemy until his true intentions are clear.

page2.text:
"Then, we will not be going out tonight, Shirou?"
"...Yeah. I'm sure it's frustrating for you, but sit tight for tonight. I don't intend to fight needless battles, and more than anything, we're not in a place to be able to fight freely."

page3.text:
I'm inexperienced as a Master, and Saber has a limit to how many times she can battle since I'm not able to provide her with any magical energy.
Given our situation, it's not a good idea to be aimlessly looking around for Masters.

page4.text:
"...Understood. You certainly do have a point. It is not proactive, but we do need to exercise utmost caution in order to win."
"...However. If you have the will to fight, we must not waste any time. If we are to stay here tonight, then we should use this time to train."

page5.text:
Saber stares at me.
She doesn't even need to tell me.
I brought Saber to this dojo with that in mind.

page6.text:
"I know. Do you remember what happened last night?
We had a match since you told me that I was slacking off for coming home late.

page7.text: "Khh...! That is because Taiga told me that I had to go hard on you or else you would not listen to me. I-it is not because I was angry yesterday—"

page8.text:
"No, it's fine. That was a good lesson.
No matter what I do, there's going to be those I can't beat.
That was never more apparent than when I fought you."

page9.text:
...
"With that in mind, I think it's important to train with you. I don't know how effective it'll be, but I should be able to survive a bit longer in battle if you're hard on me."

page10.text:
"Then, Shirou..."
"Yeah. Please train me whenever we have the time.
For today, that'll be until we go to bed."
